description: Returns the single nearest point of interest of a given category (e.g. the nearest school) with distance and travel time. Categories: school, nursery, supermarket, public_transport, train_station, motorway.

category.description: Category token, e.g. school, nursery, supermarket, train_station, motorway, public_transport

country.description: Country code (market), e.g. BE, FR, NL

language.description: Language code, e.g. fr, en, nl, de

name: yatmo_get_nearest_by_category
title: Nearest place of a category
